description: Providing urgent relief to people affected by the emergency disaster situation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-01 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Considering the emergency situation that has arisen due to the adverse weather condition, the Government has declared an extended disaster emergency situation with effect from 2025‑11‑21, until further notice. The Secretary to the Treasury has issued the Budget Circular No.05/2025, with the concurrence of the National Procurement Commission, including necessary instructions to the District Secretaries and Divisional Secretaries on the methodology to be followed in the provision of emergency relief and facilities required to restore the living condition of the people affected by the said disaster situation together, and Budget Circular No.06/2025, authorizing all the Secretaries to Ministries and Chief Secretaries of Provinces to carry out necessary procurement activities without hindrance. Additional provisions amounting to Rs.550 million have already been made in addition to the provisions allocated in the budget estimates 2025 for disaster relief services and emergency response. Similarly, approval has been granted to increase the amount paid for dry rations to the families affected by the disaster from the previous amount of Rs.1,800 to Rs.3,600 per week, from Rs.2,100 to Rs.10,500, depending upon the number of family members. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to authorize the Secretary to the Treasury to take necessary action and to provide further necessary approvals, guidelines and additional provisions for the restoration of the lives of the people disrupted by the disaster situation, was approved by the Cabinet.
